scope: Independent local review of the exact V2 one-shot CPU admission wrapper, its embedded fixed inputs, the revised terminal checker, and the retained native/profile receipt contracts. No SSH, B query, unit action, native stop/restart/replay, checker import or execution, test execution, or model/state/cache-array/dictionary payload read/hash was performed.
review_findings: The only V2 checker changes relative to the previously frozen checker are the exact launch-record contract correction and the profile initial-state digest correction. The launch helper is called immediately after reading the original admission, launch, launch-acceptance, and typed terminal receipts. It verifies exact admission/launch/acceptance hashes, the actual launch schema/unit/submitted return code, and the separate acceptance schema/status/unit/invocation/admission/launch/body SHA bindings. The retained local LAUNCH.json is exactly 6999 bytes/SHA afd19428… and has no body_sha256; the separately pinned LAUNCH_ACCEPTANCE.json is exactly 2805 bytes/SHA caa7e156… and contains body SHA 124b90f9…. The checker now reads that body SHA from the correct receipt.

The exact profile acceptance receipt is SHA 9235b167… and contains nested initial_state but no top-level initial_state_sha256. The checker retains the strict proof: it validates the nested ancestry/geometry/initialization fields, compares the nested object with the one pinned unit.log line, computes its canonical sorted compact-JSON digest, and compares that result with fixed SHA 254b2951…. I independently recomputed this digest and verified the captured ADMISSION.json, LAUNCH.json, and unit.log all match the acceptance receipt's byte/hash entries; the unit log has exactly one matching initial-state line.

The body binds a fresh read of the exact native unit and requires the same invocation, loaded/active/exited state, MainPID 0, ExecMainCode 1, ExecMainStatus 0, Result success, and positive CPU usage. It also joins the exact root-captured typed terminal receipt, raw-capture identity, nested admission/launch bytes, and captured native unit.log. The code has no native stop, restart, or replay path.

Before creating the new V2 output directory or staging files, the body checks the canonical project root and research_tmp directory, executable canonical interpreter, absent create-only output path, and absent V2 support unit. It then checks all 167 source-file hashes and exact inventory, the pinned split, registered data paths, terminal run artifact inventory and stat identities, read-only parent/dictionary/profile receipts, cache metadata/acceptance/stop and array stat identities, and current parent resource/disk headroom. Model, state, cache-array, and dictionary payload contents are not read or hashed by the admission body.

The resource limits remain 50% CPU, MemoryHigh 1400000000 bytes, MemoryMax 1500000000 bytes, swap 0, RuntimeMaxSec 600, hidden CUDA, and single-thread BLAS/WNN settings. The parent gate retains the 2-core envelope, 18 GB MemoryHigh/20 GB MemoryMax/swap 0, empty campaign cgroup descendants, current + one 1.5 GB support allowance + one 1 GB reserve < 17 GB target, at least 25 GiB free space, and rejection of tmpfs/ramfs.

All pre-mutation gates precede create-only staging. The body writes only the four pinned code files and bounded metadata inputs plus durable admission/intent records, then submits the exact V2 checker once. Timeout, OS error, or nonzero return is durably represented as unknown/failed, support invocation identity is read from post-submission properties, native invocation is stored separately, and the recorded policy forbids retry or output recreation.
non_blocking_limitations: The inherited metadata stable-read helpers use lstat, Path.open, then stat, leaving a theoretical symlink-swap race. No concrete mismatched pin was found; the downstream frozen checker separately uses O_NOFOLLOW for payload reads.

The disk gate enforces at least 25 GiB free and rejects tmpfs/ramfs but does not positively allowlist a physical filesystem type. This is inherited from V1 and is not a source blocker; the actual filesystem and free-space check remains fresh at execution time.

This review establishes source and fixed-input pin correctness only. It does not establish that fresh B-side gates pass, that the checker succeeds, that model/state tensors are intact, or that any scientific result is accepted or high quality.

reviewer_execution.actor_reported_focused_actual_byte_fixtu: Seven local fixtures reported PASS by the preparation actor; not repeated by this reviewer.

decision: PASS for one source-reviewed, create-only CPU verifier admission after its own fresh gates pass. This review is not terminal verification, artifact acceptance, model/state integrity, or scientific quality evidence.
